description: Required Microsoft Graph API permissions for Account Compromise Remediation scripts

delegatedPermissions.description: Used by the interactive script (Invoke-AccountRemediation.ps1) with interactive browser login

applicationPermissions.description: Used by the non-interactive script (Invoke-AutoRemediation.ps1) with Managed Identity

applicationPermissionsAppAuth.description: Used by Invoke-AccountRemediationAppAuth.ps1 (low-privilege analyst mode, certificate auth). Setup-ACRAppRegistration.ps1 grants admin consent for these.

graphAppRoles.name: User.ReadWrite.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Reset password, revoke sessions, read user profile

graphAppRoles.name: User-PasswordProfile.ReadWrite.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Reset password (specific scope; required for users without admin roles assigned to the app SP)

graphAppRoles.name: Directory.Read.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Read directory roles, group membership for context detection

graphAppRoles.name: AuditLog.Read.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Forensic sign-in and audit log collection

graphAppRoles.name: Mail.ReadWrite
graphAppRoles.purpose: Inspect mail/inbox rules surface where Graph supports it

graphAppRoles.name: Files.ReadWrite.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Remove SharePoint/OneDrive sharing links on user-owned items

graphAppRoles.name: Sites.ReadWrite.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Site-level access required for OneDrive permission removal

graphAppRoles.name: DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Remove user-consented and admin-consented OAuth2 grants

graphAppRoles.name: Application.ReadWrite.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Remove client secrets from app registrations the user owns

graphAppRoles.name: GroupMember.ReadWrite.All
graphAppRoles.purpose: Remove guest members from groups/teams the user owns

graphAppRoles.name: RoleManagement.Read.Directory
graphAppRoles.purpose: Read directory role assignments to determine admin context

_notes: All IDs above are Microsoft Graph application appRoleIds (resource appId 00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000). They are stable, public, and identical across tenants.
Reset of users in privileged roles requires the app's service principal to be assigned the 'Privileged Authentication Administrator' directory role (handled by Setup-ACRAppRegistration.ps1).

Power Platform actions (RemovePowerAutomateFlows, RemovePowerApps, RemovePowerAppsSharing) use a separate auth path (Add-PowerAppsAccount). The setup helper documents the manual SP registration step required there; if not configured, those actions return Skipped with manual guidance — same behavior as today when the module is missing.

exchangeOnline.description: Exchange Online PowerShell permissions required for mailbox and transport rule operations

appOnly.description: For Invoke-AccountRemediationAppAuth.ps1 the EXO service principal needs to be added to role groups. Setup-ACRAppRegistration.ps1 prints the required commands; assignment must be performed by an Exchange admin.

directoryRolesForServicePrincipal.name: Privileged Authentication Administrator
directoryRolesForServicePrincipal.purpose: Optional: required only if you must reset passwords for users in privileged roles

powerPlatform.description: Power Platform admin permissions required for Power Automate and Power Apps remediation
powerPlatform.notes: Requires Power Platform admin role or Environment Admin role. Uses Power Platform admin connectors via Microsoft Graph where available, otherwise Power Apps Management module.
